unresolved_gaps: No representative set of comparable realized LLM profit figures was established for the target quarter. Missing disclosures cannot establish that profits were scarce.
Price cuts and benchmark comparisons do not establish how readily customers could substitute models across ordinary commercial uses.
The quarterly OpenAI estimate clears the claimed monthly threshold, but the reviewed evidence does not independently reconcile the ownership-based inference to OpenAI's consolidated loss accounts.
